SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROUND( 6378.138 * 2 * ASIN( SQRT( POW( SIN( ( #{wd} * PI( ) / 180- wd * PI( ) / 180 ) / 2 ), 2 ) + COS( #{wd} * PI( ) / 180 ) * COS( WD * PI( ) / 180 ) * POW( SIN( ( #{jd} * PI( ) / 180- jd * PI( ) / 180 ) / 2 ), 2 ) ) ) ) AS jl FROM wjbd_wrj_zymb
TYPE in
#{key}
HAVING #{jl} > jl ) a

SELECT SUBTYPE as type, COUNT(*) as sl FROM ( SELECT *, ROUND( 6378.138 * 2 * ASIN( SQRT( POW( SIN( ( #{wd} * PI( ) / 180- wd * PI( ) / 180 ) / 2 ), 2 ) + COS( #{wd} * PI( ) / 180 ) * COS( WD * PI( ) / 180 ) * POW( SIN( ( #{jd} * PI( ) / 180- jd * PI( ) / 180 ) / 2 ), 2 ) ) ) ) AS jl FROM wjbd_wrj_zymb
TYPE in
#{key}
HAVING #{jl} > jl ) a GROUP BY SUBTYPE
